request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn it into a ramshackle goblin scrap warship: the pale hull becomes dark brown planks, colour #5a3414 with #391501 shadows, patched with riveted gunmetal scrap plates; the grey stone tower becomes rusty scrap iron; the red sails become patched warm brown leather, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows, with stitched hide patches; the pennants become brown rags. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
